senses.gloss: (I)--a वानर chieftain. Br. III. 7. २३२.
(II)--a son of अट्टहास अवतार् of the Lord. वा. २३. १९३.
(I)--a prince of गान्धार: his daughter was गान्धारी, and son शकुनि. भा. I. १३. २८-29; III. 1. १४; X. ८४. 1.
(II)--a son of Sumati, and father of सुनीथ. भा. IX. २२. ४८-49.
(III)--a playmate of कृष्ण: wanted to eat the fruits of the palmyra grove then in possession of Dhenuka. भा. X. १५. २०; २२ 31.
(IV)--a son of Bhautya Manu. Br. IV. 1. ११५.
(VI)--Ojasvi of the १४थ् epoch of Bhautya Manu. वा. १००. ११६.
(VII)--a son of दृडसेन and father of सुनीत. Vi. IV. २३. 8-9.

--in previous birth a son of कौशिक; born as one of the ministers of the पाञ्चाल king, Brahmadatta;
1: M. २०. २४.
son of Babhru, also called पाञ्चाल and author of कामशास्त्र; remembered his previous birth and retired from the world for penance.
2: Ib. २१. ३०.

(I)--a son of शत्रुघ्न;
1: भा. IX. ११. १२; वा. ८८. १८६; Vi. IV. 4. १०४.
his capital was मथुरा.
2: Br. III. ६३. १८७.
(II)--a son of कालिन्दी. भा. X. ६१. १४.
(III)--a son of प्रतीबाहु, and father of शान्त- sena. भा. X. ९०. ३८.
(IV)--an Apsaras. Br. III. 7. 7; वा. ६९. 6.
(V)--a Gandharva born to क्रोधा. Br. III. 7. 8.
(VI)--a वानर chieftain. Br. III. 7. २४१. [page३-644+ २४]
(VII)--a son of हृदीक. Br. III. ७१. १४१.
(VIII)--a sage of the Raivata epoch. M. 9. १९.
(IX)--a son of अश्विनी and अक्रूर. M. ४५. ३२.
(X)--a Gandharva king in कैलास. वा. ४१. २१.
(XI)--a राक्षस killed by राम. Vi. IV. 4. 100
(I)--fought with Pradyumna at शोणित- pura: defeated, returned from the field. Visited by बलराम. भा. X. ६३. 7 & १५; ७९. १३.
(II)--one of the १६ R2tviks for an यज्ञ; from the knees of नारायण. M. १६७. १०.
